main_text.head: ETHICI.
main_text.l: Loci Ethici.1 Sapientia, prudentia, calliditas, circumspectio. 53

page.notes: The entry 29 is cut off at the foot of the page; the word after "Mise-" is not visible, so it is given with [?] and the rest is not supplied. The entry "Iustitia" is printed with a J-like initial, normalised to I as a vowel. "circumspectio" is printed with a long s, rendered as plain s. The page numbers 53 to 80 run in the right column, aligned with each entry. The left-margin label "Loci Ethici." is treated as a note. No catchword or signature is printed.
